identificationModule.briefTitle: Radiation Therapy With or Without Bicalutamide for Recurrent pT3N0 Prostate Cancer After Radical Prostatectomy
identificationModule.officialTitle: A PHASE III TRIAL OF RADIATION THERAPY WITH OR WITHOUT CASODEX IN PATIENTS WITH PSA ELEVATION FOLLOWING RADICAL PROSTATECTOMY FOR pT3N0 CARCINOMA OF THE PROSTATE

interventions.name: bicalutamide
interventions.description: One (150 mg) tablet by mouth daily for two years beginning immediately upon, or just prior to, the initiation of irradiation.

interventions.name: radiation therapy
interventions.description: 64.8 Gy in 36 fractions (1.8 Gy in 5 daily sessions per week) to the original prostate volume, the tumor resection bed, and the proximal membranous urethra.

interventions.name: placebo
interventions.description: One tablet by mouth daily for two years beginning immediately upon, or just prior to, the initiation of irradiation.
